title: Al-Ghasali: A Computational Framework for Simulating Islamic Jurisprudential Rulings via Finite State Automata and Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.17235v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper presents Al Ghasali, a computational framework designed to formalize and simulate Islamic jurisprudential (Fiqh) rulings. Building upon recent set theoretic formalizations of al sabr wa al Taqsim that extract minimal operational rules as simple Horn clause logical programs, this work proves that the semantics of closed Fiqh chapters collapse completely to deterministic Finite State Automata (FSA). We establish a formal computational hierarchy, demonstrating that restricting formalization to finite propositional Horn theories guarantees decidability and constant time (O(1)) verdict extraction after offline compilation. The framework formally proves that hierarchical compositions of sub-chapter FSAs preserve this O(1) complexity, and that temporal juristic requirements, such as Tartib (order), are deterministically flattened into static ontological states, preserving the memoryless property of the automaton. translated_title: Al-Ghasali：基于有限状态自动机与大语言模型模拟伊斯兰教法学裁决的计算框架
translated_abstract: 本文提出了Al-Ghasali，一个旨在形式化与模拟伊斯兰教法学裁决的计算框架。在近期集合论形式化工作的基础上——该工作将“困境与分配”提取为简单Horn子句逻辑程序中的最小操作规则——本研究证明了封闭教法章节的语义可完全坍缩为确定性有限状态自动机（FSA）。我们建立了一个形式化的计算层级，证明将形式化限定于有限命题Horn理论可保证可判定性，并在离线编译后实现常数时间（O(1)）的裁决提取。该框架形式化地证明了子章节自动机的分层组合能够保持这一O(1)复杂度，并且时间性的教法要求（如Tartib（顺序））被确定性地扁平化为静态本体状态，从而保留了自动机的无记忆特性。为生成人类可……（原文摘要在此处截断）
